description: add tests for settle_up (judged by deliberate bugs)

issue.title: Add tests for settle_up
issue.body:
`settle_up` is the core of the library but has no tests at all. Please add some in a new `tests/test_settle.py`.

Cases worth covering:

- one debtor paying one creditor
- several debtors and creditors
- balances that are already all zero returns an empty list
- applying the returned transfers to the input balances brings every balance to zero
- the output is deterministic when amounts tie (ordering is alphabetical by name)
